title: Three-Faced Angel
description: A central purple-skinned figure with three distinct female faces stands in a barren purple field. The being has large white feathered wings, is wrapped in torn bandages, holds a glowing red orb in one hand, and is surrounded by geometric symbols against a dark sky with two red suns.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy painting of a tall purple-skinned female figure with three distinct faces, large white feathered angel wings, wrapped in torn bloody bandages and orange-blue robes, holding a glowing red orb, standing in a cracked purple field under a black sky with two red suns and floating geometric symbols and constellations
